description: POST /v1/capabilities/resolve: rank capabilities from natural-language intent. Use when the capability key is unknown; use hydracept_capabilities when you already have a key or need the catalog list/search. Auth: none (keyless). Cost: none. Side effects: none.

intent.description: Required string: user goal in natural language (passed verbatim to the resolver).
intent.title: Intent

requirements.description: Optional object matching CapabilityResolutionRequest.requirements (e.g. modality tags). Default {}. runnableNow requires an authenticated project workspace on the API.
requirements.title: Requirements

name: resolve_capability
title: Resolve a capability
